name: Can you do it?
source:
Ryuuma promised himself to confess to his childhood friend to-day, but he's yet wavering and hesitating.  Can he do it?

[From [url=https://defrauder.itch.io/can-you-do-it]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
龙马答应自己今天要向青梅竹马告白，但他仍然犹豫不决。他能做到吗？

[来自[url=https://defrauder.itch.io/can-you-do-it]Itch.io[/url]]
